objective: test whether controller-bound full-match utility improves three-round match score, whether raw policy evaluation or isotonic optimal-value regularization is safer, and whether the table should act from ply 0 or ply 14

must_freeze: current remote commit after all accepted patches

gcc executable plus required semantic version 13.3.0 obtained with the exact command gcc -dumpfullversion -dumpversion, target architecture, optimization flags, floating-point flags, and expected match-value build-profile word
source commit and hashes of match-value/controller source files
deterministic table-build command, seed, samples, role schedule, and output paths
add_only_execution_binding_required_befo.rule: the sole launch commit must add only the execution binding, must name the independently committed authoritative world800 result, and must exist before either table is built; table generation itself is not an efficacy test

must_freeze: raw and isotonic table paths, SHA-256 values, payload fingerprints, and maximum projection adjustments
winning rollout world cap and complete mechanically constructed actor strings

required compiler semantic version and version-query command, observed full compiler package banner, uname, GitHub runner ImageOS/ImageVersion/RUNNER_OS/RUNNER_ARCH fields, optimization flags, source commit, source hashes, and observed match-value build-profile word
the predeclared match commands, development and reserved-final seeds, reciprocal orientations, pair counts, shard matrices, and mechanical rules
pre_efficacy_generated_build_manifest.rule: do not run a single efficacy match until this no-clobber manifest exists, verifies both artifacts against the add-only prebuild binding, and is included in the immutable transported evaluator

execution_protocol.launch: one non-forced, first-attempt push adding only data/experiments/locked_match_value_variant_execution.json
execution_protocol.compile_and_build: compile one arena and one table builder from the sole parent tree; invoke the table builder exactly once to emit the raw and isotonic pair from shared transition histograms
execution_protocol.inspection_firewall: each efficacy matrix job emits raw rows only; the downstream job first requires every expected shard and sidecar for the complete stage before any reciprocal merge, gate, or selection
execution_protocol.conditional_path: stage 1 mechanically selects one of R14/P14/R0/P0; stage 2 evaluates only it; the reserved final matrix runs automatically only if the exact stage-2 development gate passes
execution_protocol.promotion_behavior: the workflow uploads a promotion recommendation and all evidence but never edits a branch, checkpoint, default actor, or repository file

inactive_dimension_note.reason: the frozen actor has semantic_cand=0, no draw or planner extras, policy_prefix_mode=3, and all generated candidates marked trusted; the low-prior qualifier therefore never consults override_min
inactive_dimension_note.verified_effect: actors differing only in override_min serialize byte-for-byte identically for this controller
inactive_dimension_note.decision: hold override_min at 2.0 and do not spend matches pretending to tune an unreachable parameter

baseline.name: legacy
baseline.description: authoritative winner of the locked world800 campaign, including its winning world cap

stage_1_factorial_screen.purpose: estimate the raw/projected by ply14/all-ply interaction without adaptive threshold screening
stage_1_factorial_screen.selection_rule: maximize equal-weight mean match score over the two reciprocal blocks; then maximize equal-weight mean margin; if still exactly tied use the fixed order P14, R14, P0, R0
stage_1_factorial_screen.failure_rule: reject the whole screen if any shard is missing, any raw pair row is missing or duplicated, any cap occurs, or either artifact fails validation

stage_2_development_confirmation.participant: mechanical winner of stage 1 versus legacy
stage_2_development_confirmation.pass_rule: combined equal-weight reciprocal match score is above 50%, each reciprocal block is above 50%, combined equal-weight margin is positive, capped rounds are zero, and every raw-pair and artifact validation check passes
stage_2_development_confirmation.interpretation: development evidence only; passing activates the already bound disjoint final reservation but does not promote the actor

locked_final_test_reservation.promotion_gate: combined pair-clustered 95% one-sided lower confidence bound (the lower endpoint of the equivalent 90% two-sided confidence interval, using z=1.645) is above 50%, point estimate is above 50%, each reciprocal block is above 50%, combined equal-weight margin is positive, capped rounds are zero, and all exact integrity checks pass
locked_final_test_reservation.failure_behavior: retain the authoritative world800 winner; no repository promotion is performed by the workflow

attribution_caveat: objective 3 changes both early-round Bellman continuation utility and final-round utility from pure margin to the declared hybrid match utility; a strength result establishes the complete actor's effect, not isolated causality for the Bellman table. Objective 2 is a future attribution control, not part of this preregistered strength panel.
